import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a histogram of sleep duration
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(data['Sleep Duration'], kde=True, binwidth=0.5)
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Duration')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_sleep_duration.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of sleep quality
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='Quality of Sleep', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Quality')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Quality')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_sleep_quality.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot of heart rate vs daily steps
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Daily Steps', y='Heart Rate', data=data)
plt.title('Relationship between Daily Steps and Heart Rate')
plt.xlabel('Daily Steps')
plt.ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_heart_rate_steps.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of physical activity level
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='Physical Activity Level', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Physical Activity Level')
plt.xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_physical_activity.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of stress level
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='Stress Level', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Stress Level')
plt.xlabel('Stress Level')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_stress_level.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of bmi category
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='BMI Category', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of BMI Category')
plt.xlabel('BMI Category')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_bmi_category.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.close('all')
